Title: Retirement: Azure CDN Standard/Premium from Edgio (formerly Verizon) will be retired

Body.Content:
All Azure CDN from Edgio customers must migrate their workloads to Azure Front Door or other CDN services before January 15, 2025 as Edgio has advised their platform is currently scheduled to be shut down by that date. Migrate as soon as possible to avoid an imminent service shut-down.


Microsoft's flagship CDN product, Azure Front Door Standard or Premium, is our recommended replacement and we encourage you to consider migrating your compatible workloads there. View the comparison between Azure Front Door and Azure CDN from Edgio. Azure Front Door compatible workloads can use these step-by-step instructions.


For more details, please visit our learn page here and/or contact Microsoft Support.
